posts.text: I’m excited to share that Fae has been acquired by Tomo! Over the past year, my team and I built Fae around one belief: as intelligence becomes a commodity, emotional intelligence and culture become the moat. Fae was our early bet on that. If you're unsure about pursuing in tech, I recommend signing up for your first hackathon. You don't need any technical experience and it's beginner-friendly because of the helpful mentors and resources available for you to use at will. On the other hand, if you have any experience in tech, consider applying as a mentor for Hack the North. It's a chance to guide newcomers and possibly spark someone's passion for technology.
